transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions — on lockdowns, travel bans, or resource allocation — without knowing true prevalence, IFR, and transmission rate; this is the single highest-value action in week one.

actions.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions — on lockdowns, travel bans, or resource allocation — without knowing true prevalence, IFR, and transmission rate; this is the single highest-value action in week one.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Slowing importation of new cases buys critical days or weeks to stand up domestic response capacity before the window closes.

actions.rationale: Slowing importation of new cases buys critical days or weeks to stand up domestic response capacity before the window closes.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Shortages of PPE, tests, and ventilators have historically been the binding constraint in novel-pathogen crises; invoking DPA now, before demand spikes, prevents a deadly supply gap later.

actions.rationale: Shortages of PPE, tests, and ventilators have historically been the binding constraint in novel-pathogen crises; invoking DPA now, before demand spikes, prevents a deadly supply gap later.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine development timelines are long; launching a crash public-private program in week one could compress the timeline by months and is the ultimate off-ramp from the crisis.

actions.rationale: Vaccine development timelines are long; launching a crash public-private program in week one could compress the timeline by months and is the ultimate off-ramp from the crisis.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Transparent, data-driven communication builds the public trust needed for compliance with future measures and prevents the panic and misinformation that fill a vacuum of silence.

actions.rationale: Transparent, data-driven communication builds the public trust needed for compliance with future measures and prevents the panic and misinformation that fill a vacuum of silence.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A real-time national data dashboard aligns federal, state, and local authorities around the same facts and signals to the public that the government has situational awareness.

actions.rationale: A real-time national data dashboard aligns federal, state, and local authorities around the same facts and signals to the public that the government has situational awareness.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Emergency spending authority and legislative backing must be secured now, before the crisis deepens and before political windows close.

actions.rationale: Emergency spending authority and legislative backing must be secured now, before the crisis deepens and before political windows close.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens. Roughly 2 more deaths reported this week.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 2.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 15/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: With infection index at 1.8 and rising, masking is a high-benefit, low-cost, low-disruption intervention that can reduce transmission without shutting down the economy or inflaming governors.

actions.rationale: With infection index at 1.8 and rising, masking is a high-benefit, low-cost, low-disruption intervention that can reduce transmission without shutting down the economy or inflaming governors.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Until IFR is confirmed, concentrating protection on the elderly and high-risk maximizes lives saved per dollar spent and keeps broader society functioning while data matures.

actions.rationale: Until IFR is confirmed, concentrating protection on the elderly and high-risk maximizes lives saved per dollar spent and keeps broader society functioning while data matures.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Early relief signals to households and small businesses that the government has their back, dampening panic-driven economic contraction and sustaining compliance with health measures.

actions.rationale: Early relief signals to households and small businesses that the government has their back, dampening panic-driven economic contraction and sustaining compliance with health measures.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust at 58/100 is fragile; consistent, honest data-driven briefings are the cheapest way to hold it and ensure the public cooperates with escalating measures if needed.

actions.rationale: Public trust at 58/100 is fragile; consistent, honest data-driven briefings are the cheapest way to hold it and ensure the public cooperates with escalating measures if needed.

transcript.narrative: Roughly 3 more deaths reported this week.

transcript.sitrep:
DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 3.0 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 5.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 61/100. Hospital strain 25/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 58/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: An infection index of 3.0 spreading across a dozen new states means voluntary measures cannot bend this curve — strong federal guidance is needed now before hospital strain becomes irreversible, while we still have economic and public-trust headroom to absorb it.

actions.rationale: An infection index of 3.0 spreading across a dozen new states means voluntary measures cannot bend this curve — strong federal guidance is needed now before hospital strain becomes irreversible, while we still have economic and public-trust headroom to absorb it.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Confidence remains LOW after three weeks; with spread now national, we urgently need granular prevalence and severity data to calibrate how long and hard restrictions must hold.

actions.rationale: Confidence remains LOW after three weeks; with spread now national, we urgently need granular prevalence and severity data to calibrate how long and hard restrictions must hold.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: The cluster event will generate intense conflicting narratives — daily transparent briefings anchored in data are essential to hold public trust at 61 and prevent panic or complacency from undermining compliance.

actions.rationale: The cluster event will generate intense conflicting narratives — daily transparent briefings anchored in data are essential to hold public trust at 61 and prevent panic or complacency from undermining compliance.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Issuing lockdown guidance without simultaneous economic support will collapse small businesses and household incomes, undermining both compliance and the economy index we've worked to protect.

actions.rationale: Issuing lockdown guidance without simultaneous economic support will collapse small businesses and household incomes, undermining both compliance and the economy index we've worked to protect.
